en: Black‑and‑white view of a large arched steel bridge spanning a wide river. The bridge has a prominent central arch with vertical supports and lower approach spans on either side. In the foreground there is a riverside embankment and some moored boats or barges. At the lower left corner, white printed text reads "De nieuwe Waalbrug". The overall style resembles an early– to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.
